bibl.title: Excerpt from the Book of Questions
ܟܬܒܐ ܕܫܘܐܠܐ
bibl.author: Joseph Hazzaya — ܝܘܣܦ ܚܙܝܐ

noteGrp.note: An eighth-century East-Syriac monastic and mystical work by Joseph Hazzaya, transmitted under the name of his brother ʿAbdishoʿ Hazzaya. It examines the signs by which the activity of the Holy Spirit may be discerned in the ascetic.

note.quote: ܕܐܝܟܢܐ ܡܬܝܕܥܐ ܪܘܚܐ ܕܡܥܒܕܐ ܒܢ. ܘܒܡܢܐ ܡܬܓܠܐ ܚܝܠܗ. ܘܡܢܘ ܫܘܘܕܥܐ ܕܪܘܚܐ ܟܕ ܡܚܘܐ ܒܢ ܡܥܒܕܢܘܬܗ.ܫܘܘܕܥܐ ܕܝܢ ܩܕܡܝܐ ܕܡܥܒܕܢܡܬܐ ܕܣܥܘܪܘܬܗ ܕܪܘܚܐ ܗܢܘ.ܕܝܩܕ ܒܠܒܗ ܕܒܪܢܫܐ ܚܘܫܒܐ ܕܪܚܡܬ ܐܠܗܐ ܐܝܟ ܢܘܪܐ.

On how the Spirit which works in us is known, in what His power is revealed, and what is the sign by which the Spirit makes manifest His working in us. The first sign of the effective working of the Spirit is when the love of God burns in the heart of a man like fire.
ܗܢܘ ܦܪܘܫܢܐ ܒܝܬ ܕܡܘܬܐ ܩܢܘܡܝܬܐ ܠܦܬܟܪܝܬܐ: ܘܗܠܝܢ ܐܢܘܢ ܣܡܡܢܐ ܕܐܣܝܘܬܐ ܕܟܠ ܚܕܐ ܡܢܗܝܢ. ܡܛܠ ܕܫܘܒܚܐ ܣܪܝܩܐ ܘܪܡܘܬܐ ܘܚܬܝܪܘܬܐ: ܣܓܝ ܨܝܪܝܢ ܘܡܪܟܒܝܢ ܠܕܡܘܬܐ ܩܢܘܡܝܬܐ:

This is the difference between personal and material images, and these are the remedies for the healing of each one of them. It is seen that vainglory, pride and self-esteem form and constitute to a large extent the personal images.
